Development timeline

Dates below are taken from file names; they are not independently verified event times.

Evidence-backed milestones

  • October 23: Landscape adoption and save evidence preceded the 0.2.17 alpha native activation. The activation report's client-tool and dirty-package findings are historical snapshots.
  • October 23: World Partition multi-sculpt execution produced two riverbed extensions. Manual-save verification did not establish independent reload.
  • October 23–24: Stage 2E isolated reload execution was blocked before independent Landscape acceptance; offline startup diagnosis identified a probable TedsOutliner startup-order path.
  • October 24: Controlled reset returned the earlier experimental riverbed region to zero in the loaded Editor and documented later save evidence.
  • October 24: Basin, offset lobe, and west hill demonstration stopped after the west hill's validation_failed_partial result. Reconciliation explained the stale full-layer preview expectation and recorded a scoped save. Latest terrain acceptance passed live collision and package checks, while independent disk reload and close-up visual inspection remained blocked.
